slides.text: The solar salesman at your door wants a signature today.
Hawaii's consumer protection office has warned about misleading door-to-door solar sales.

slides.sub: “Free” solar. A “state program.” Claims the seller works with the State.

slides.text:
Already signed?
You have 3 business days to cancel.
slides.sub: Use them to make sure your contract is clean.

slides.text: If you haven't signed yet, verify your own numbers first.
slides.sub: Your roof. Your bill. Nobody in your living room pressuring you for a signed contract.
